roles.rail: var(--accent, var(--red)) at 0.5 opacity; hover/active opacity 1
roles.send_mic: var(--fg) on color-mix(in srgb, var(--send-btn-bg, var(--red)) 30%, var(--panel))

css_rules.css: .icon-rail-btn:hover { opacity: 1; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent); }
.icon-rail-btn.active-section { opacity: 1; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 15%, transparent); }

limits: Component color harness, not a running Odysseus server.
Production styles do not define --accent globally; fallbacks and invalid no-fallback color-mix declarations are preserved.
Source-label icon mapping is a candidate replacement map, not an automatic integration patch.
Provider glyphs are neutral identifiers, not official vendor logos.
